stability_policy.maximum_width_basis: one fiftieth of the frozen 5-percent SMALL threshold, preregistered before W1 real subsets
stability_policy.near_zero_negative_relief_rule: if V(G)-V(W) is negative by no more than the W0 synthetic-calibrated volume stability limit, record raw value and use zero only for category; otherwise numeric failure
stability_policy.topology_rule: same T0 state and solid count across both paths, repeats, BREP and FCStd reopen; one solid CONNECTED_SINGLE_SOLID, multiple solids DISCONNECTED_MULTI_SOLID, empty EFFECTIVELY_EMPTY
stability_policy.category_boundary_policy: crossing 0.05 or 0.15 is explicitly NUMERICALLY_AMBIGUOUS, not forced to either side

fatal_exception_policy: continue per subset after local Boolean failure; stop only on corrupt shared source or frozen input mismatch
